title: The faction treasury is one typed account; an inheritance moves goods once; a repair is charged once; coin is conserved over a run
summary: One typed treasury per bucket, inheritance moves goods once, repair charged once, ground coin purse, gold sink retired

title: Tax is a tenth of a sale or a wage, paid to the place holder's treasury; the per-head levy is retired
summary: Decision 51: tax is a tenth of sales and wages to the place holders treasury

title: A treasury pays upkeep into the building's own purse, and the building pays town work; the +10 building mint is removed
summary: Decision 37/58 and ruling 61: a building meets upkeep from its own purse, the treasury tops up a shortfall

title: Kill and quest coin is paid by a payer: the body's own coin is looted, a quest reward is treasury-funded or owed
summary: Decision 38 and ruling 61: a kill mints no coin, a quest is paid by its one real giver or owed
